ventes_par_categorie.description: Montant total des ventes (CA HT/TTC) par catégorie de produit
ventes_par_categorie.sql: SELECT c.label AS categorie, COALESCE(SUM(cd.total_ht), 0) AS ca_ht, COALESCE(SUM(cd.total_ttc), 0) AS ca_ttc FROM m38h_commandedet cd JOIN m38h_product p ON p.rowid = cd.fk_product LEFT JOIN m38h_categorie_product cp ON cp.fk_product = p.rowid LEFT JOIN m38h_categorie c ON c.rowid = cp.fk_categorie WHERE p.entity = 1 GROUP BY c.rowid, c.label ORDER BY ca_ttc DESC LIMIT :limit

stock_faible.description: Produits dont le stock est inférieur à un seuil donné
stock_faible.sql:
SELECT p.ref,
       p.label AS produit,
       ps.reel AS stock_actuel,
       e.label AS entrepot
FROM m38h_product p
JOIN m38h_product_stock ps ON ps.fk_product = p.rowid
JOIN m38h_entrepot e ON e.rowid = ps.fk_entrepot
WHERE ps.reel < :seuil
  AND p.tosell = 1
ORDER BY ps.reel ASC
LIMIT :limit

commandes_par_mois.description: Nombre et total des commandes pour un mois donné
commandes_par_mois.sql:
SELECT 
    COUNT(c.rowid) AS nb_commandes,
    DATE_FORMAT(c.date_commande, '%Y-%m') AS mois,
    SUM(c.total_ht) AS total_ht,
    SUM(c.total_ttc) AS total_ttc
FROM m38h_commande c
WHERE YEAR(c.date_commande) = :annee
  AND MONTH(c.date_commande) = :mois
  AND c.entity = 1
GROUP BY mois
LIMIT 200

top_clients_ca.description: Top N clients avec le chiffre d'affaires le plus élevé
top_clients_ca.sql:
SELECT 
    s.nom AS client,
    COUNT(f.rowid) AS nb_factures,
    SUM(f.total_ht) AS CA_HT,
    SUM(f.total_ttc) AS CA_TTC
FROM m38h_facture f
JOIN m38h_societe s ON f.fk_soc = s.rowid
WHERE f.entity = 1
  AND f.fk_statut != 0
GROUP BY s.rowid, s.nom
ORDER BY CA_TTC DESC
LIMIT :limit

factures_par_client.description: Factures d’un client avec total HT et TTC
factures_par_client.sql:
SELECT f.ref, s.nom AS client, f.total_ht, f.total_ttc
FROM m38h_facture f
JOIN m38h_societe s ON f.fk_soc = s.rowid
WHERE s.nom LIKE :client
AND f.entity = 1
LIMIT :limit
keywords: liste des factures pour le client

ca_mois_courant.description: Chiffre d'affaires (HT et TTC) du mois en cours
ca_mois_courant.sql: SELECT SUM(f.total_ht) AS CA_HT, SUM(f.total_ttc) AS CA_TTC FROM m38h_facture f WHERE f.entity = 1 AND YEAR(f.datef) = YEAR(CURDATE()) AND MONTH(f.datef) = MONTH(CURDATE()) LIMIT 1
keywords: mon chiffre d'affaires de ce mois
quel est mon chiffre d'affaires de ce mois

produits_non_commandes.description: Produits qui n'ont jamais été commandés
produits_non_commandes.sql:
SELECT p.rowid, p.ref, p.label
FROM m38h_product p
LEFT JOIN m38h_commandedet cd ON cd.fk_product = p.rowid
WHERE cd.fk_product IS NULL
AND p.entity = 1
LIMIT :limit

get_average_order_value_by_client.description: Valeur moyenne des commandes par client
get_average_order_value_by_client.sql:
SELECT s.nom AS client,
       AVG(c.total_ttc) AS valeur_moyenne_commande
FROM m38h_commande c
JOIN m38h_societe s ON c.fk_soc = s.rowid
WHERE c.entity = 1
GROUP BY s.nom
ORDER BY valeur_moyenne_commande DESC
LIMIT :limit

get_monthly_growth_revenue.description: Évolution mensuelle du chiffre d'affaires avec taux de croissance
get_monthly_growth_revenue.sql:
SELECT 
    YEAR(f.datef) AS annee,
    MONTH(f.datef) AS mois,
    SUM(f.total_ttc) AS chiffre_affaires,
    LAG(SUM(f.total_ttc)) OVER (ORDER BY YEAR(f.datef), MONTH(f.datef)) AS ca_mois_precedent,
    (SUM(f.total_ttc) - LAG(SUM(f.total_ttc)) OVER (ORDER BY YEAR(f.datef), MONTH(f.datef)))
        / LAG(SUM(f.total_ttc)) OVER (ORDER BY YEAR(f.datef), MONTH(f.datef)) * 100 AS croissance_pct
FROM m38h_facture f
WHERE f.entity = 1
GROUP BY YEAR(f.datef), MONTH(f.datef)
ORDER BY annee, mois
LIMIT :limit

top_produits_ca.description: Top des produits générant le plus de chiffre d'affaires (CA)
top_produits_ca.sql:
SELECT
    p.ref,
    p.label AS produit,
    COALESCE(SUM(cd.total_ht), 0) AS ca_ht,
    COALESCE(SUM(cd.total_ttc), 0) AS ca_ttc,
    COALESCE(SUM(cd.qty), 0) AS quantite
FROM m38h_commandedet cd
JOIN m38h_product p ON p.rowid = cd.fk_product
WHERE p.entity = 1
GROUP BY p.rowid, p.ref, p.label
ORDER BY ca_ttc DESC
LIMIT :limit

top_fournisseurs_achats.description: Top des fournisseurs selon le montant total des achats
top_fournisseurs_achats.sql:
SELECT
    s.nom AS fournisseur,
    COUNT(f.rowid) AS nb_factures,
    COALESCE(SUM(f.total_ht), 0) AS total_achats_ht,
    COALESCE(SUM(f.total_ttc), 0) AS total_achats_ttc
FROM m38h_facture_fourn f
JOIN m38h_societe s ON s.rowid = f.fk_soc
WHERE f.entity = 1
GROUP BY s.rowid, s.nom
ORDER BY total_achats_ttc DESC
LIMIT :limit

recap_ventes_reglements.description: Récapitulatif comptable des ventes et des règlements par magasin et période
recap_ventes_reglements.sql:
SELECT
    f.rowid AS id,
    f.ref AS facture_ref,
    f.datef AS DATE,
    CASE WHEN f.type = 2 THEN 'AVOIR' WHEN f.type = 0 THEN 'FAC' ELSE 'TK' END AS TYPE,
    f.ref AS NFACT,
    CASE WHEN f.type <> 2 THEN ROUND(f.total_ttc, 3) ELSE 0 END AS VENTESTTC,
    CASE WHEN f.type = 2 THEN ROUND(ABS(f.total_ttc), 3) ELSE 0 END AS AVOIRSTTC,
    ROUND(f.total_ht, 3) AS MONTANTHTAvantRemise,
    0 AS REMISE,
    ROUND(f.total_ht, 3) AS MONTANTHT,
    ROUND(f.total_ttc - f.total_ht, 3) AS TVA,
    ROUND(f.total_ttc, 3) AS MONTANTTTC,
    ROUND(COALESCE(f.revenuestamp, 0), 3) AS TIMBRE,
    ROUND(f.total_ttc + COALESCE(f.revenuestamp, 0), 3) AS `NET A Payer`,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN cp.code = 'LIQ' THEN COALESCE(pf.amount, 0) ELSE 0 END), 3) AS ESPECES,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN cp.code IN ('CB', 'BANCON', 'CARTE') THEN COALESCE(pf.amount, 0) ELSE 0 END), 3) AS CARTES,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN cp.code = 'CHQ' THEN COALESCE(pf.amount, 0) ELSE 0 END), 3) AS CHEQUE,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN cp.code = 'VIR' THEN COALESCE(pf.amount, 0) ELSE 0 END), 3) AS VIREMENT,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN cp.code IN ('FID', 'BON') THEN COALESCE(pf.amount, 0) ELSE 0 END), 3) AS BonAchatCRK,
    0 AS TotalRS,
    CASE WHEN f.type = 2 THEN ROUND(ABS(f.total_ttc), 3) ELSE 0 END AS TotalAv,
    0 AS TotalAc,
    f.pos_source_name AS MAGASIN
FROM m38h_facture f
LEFT JOIN m38h_paiement_facture pf ON pf.fk_facture = f.rowid
LEFT JOIN m38h_paiement p ON p.rowid = pf.fk_paiement
LEFT JOIN m38h_c_paiement cp ON cp.id = p.fk_paiement
WHERE f.entity = 1
  AND f.datef BETWEEN :date_debut AND :date_fin
  AND (:magasin IS NULL OR f.pos_source_name = :magasin)
GROUP BY f.rowid, f.datef, f.type, f.ref, f.total_ttc, f.total_ht, f.revenuestamp, f.pos_source_name
ORDER BY f.datef ASC, f.ref ASC
LIMIT :limit

achats_par_fournisseur.sql:
SELECT
    e.ref AS Entrepot,
    YEAR(r.tms) AS An,
    DATE_FORMAT(r.tms, '%M') AS `Libelle Mois`,
    s.nom AS Fournisseur,
    SUM(rd.qty) AS TotalQte,
    ROUND(SUM(rd.cost_price), 3) AS TotalAchat
FROM m38h_reception r
LEFT JOIN m38h_receptiondet_batch rd ON r.rowid = rd.fk_reception
LEFT JOIN m38h_entrepot e ON e.rowid = rd.fk_entrepot
LEFT JOIN m38h_societe s ON r.fk_soc = s.rowid
WHERE r.fk_statut = 2
  AND (e.ref = :entrepot OR :entrepot IS NULL)
  AND (s.nom = :fournisseur OR :fournisseur IS NULL)
  AND r.tms BETWEEN :date_debut AND :date_fin
GROUP BY e.ref, YEAR(r.tms), DATE_FORMAT(r.tms, '%M'), s.nom
ORDER BY An DESC, `Libelle Mois` ASC, TotalAchat, Fournisseur, Entrepot DESC
LIMIT :limit

listes_approvisionnements.description: Liste des approvisionnements (réceptions) par magasin, fournisseur, nature, référence et période
listes_approvisionnements.sql:
SELECT
    r.rowid AS id,
    r.ref AS Reference,
    e.ref AS Magasin,
    DATE_FORMAT(r.tms, '%d/%m/%Y') AS Date,
    s.nom AS Fournisseur,
    'Réception' AS Nature,
    0 AS Echeance,
    0 AS Cloture,
    SUM(rd.qty) AS TotalQuantite,
    ROUND(SUM(rd.cost_price), 3) AS TotalHT
FROM m38h_reception r
LEFT JOIN m38h_receptiondet_batch rd ON r.rowid = rd.fk_reception
LEFT JOIN m38h_entrepot e ON e.rowid = rd.fk_entrepot
LEFT JOIN m38h_societe s ON r.fk_soc = s.rowid
WHERE r.fk_statut = 2
  AND (e.ref = :magasin OR :magasin IS NULL)
  AND (s.nom = :fournisseur OR :fournisseur IS NULL)
  AND (r.ref = :reference OR :reference IS NULL)
  AND r.tms BETWEEN :date_debut AND :date_fin
GROUP BY e.ref, r.tms, s.nom, r.ref
ORDER BY r.tms ASC
LIMIT :limit;

analyse_mouvements_stock.description: Analyse des mouvements de stock (entrées, sorties, ventes, réceptions, transferts, inventaires)
analyse_mouvements_stock.sql:
SELECT  
    DATE(sm.datem) AS `Date`,
    COALESCE(e.ref, 'Sans Entrepôt') AS `Entrepôt`,
    p.ref AS `Reference`,
    p.barcode AS `Barcode`,
    p.label AS `Designation`,
    CASE sm.type_mouvement 
        WHEN 0 THEN 'Entree'
        WHEN 1 THEN 'Sortie'
        WHEN 2 THEN 'Vente'
        WHEN 3 THEN 'Reception'
        WHEN 4 THEN 'Transfert'
        WHEN 5 THEN 'Inventaire'
        ELSE ''
    END AS `Type Mouvement`,
    sm.value AS `Quantite`,
    sm.label AS `Libelle Mouvement`,
    ROUND(sm.price, 3) AS `Prix Unitaire`,
    ROUND(sm.price * sm.value, 2) AS `Valeur Totale`,
    
    (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT pav.value SEPARATOR '/')
     FROM m38h_product_attribute_combination pac2
     JOIN m38h_product_attribute_combination2val pac2v2 ON pac2.rowid = pac2v2.fk_prod_combination
     JOIN m38h_product_attribute_value pav ON pac2v2.fk_prod_attr_val = pav.rowid
     JOIN m38h_product_attribute pa2 ON pac2v2.fk_prod_attr = pa2.rowid
     WHERE pac2.fk_product_child = p.rowid AND pa2.label = 'Taille') AS `Taille`,
    
    (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT pav.value SEPARATOR '/')
     FROM m38h_product_attribute_combination pac2
     JOIN m38h_product_attribute_combination2val pac2v2 ON pac2.rowid = pac2v2.fk_prod_combination
     JOIN m38h_product_attribute_value pav ON pac2v2.fk_prod_attr_val = pav.rowid
     JOIN m38h_product_attribute pa2 ON pac2v2.fk_prod_attr = pa2.rowid
     WHERE pac2.fk_product_child = p.rowid AND pa2.label = 'Couleur') AS `Couleur`,
    
    COALESCE(ef.matiere, (SELECT ef2.matiere FROM m38h_product_extrafields ef2 JOIN m38h_product p2 ON p2.rowid = ef2.fk_object WHERE p2.ref = SUBSTRING_INDEX(p.ref, '-', 1) LIMIT 1)) AS `Matiere`,
    COALESCE(ef.saison, (SELECT ef2.saison FROM m38h_product_extrafields ef2 JOIN m38h_product p2 ON p2.rowid = ef2.fk_object WHERE p2.ref = SUBSTRING_INDEX(p.ref, '-', 1) LIMIT 1)) AS `Saison`,
    COALESCE(ef.marque, (SELECT ef2.marque FROM m38h_product_extrafields ef2 JOIN m38h_product p2 ON p2.rowid = ef2.fk_object WHERE p2.ref = SUBSTRING_INDEX(p.ref, '-', 1) LIMIT 1)) AS `Marque`,
    COALESCE(ef.rayon, (SELECT ef2.rayon FROM m38h_product_extrafields ef2 JOIN m38h_product p2 ON p2.rowid = ef2.fk_object WHERE p2.ref = SUBSTRING_INDEX(p.ref, '-', 1) LIMIT 1)) AS `Rayon`,
    c.label AS `Categorie`,
    pn.label AS `Nature`
FROM m38h_stock_mouvement sm
LEFT JOIN m38h_product p ON p.rowid = sm.fk_product
LEFT JOIN m38h_entrepot e ON e.rowid = sm.fk_entrepot
LEFT JOIN m38h_product_extrafields ef ON ef.fk_object = p.rowid
LEFT JOIN m38h_categorie_product cp ON cp.fk_product = p.rowid
LEFT JOIN m38h_categorie c ON c.rowid = cp.fk_categorie
LEFT JOIN m38h_c_product_nature pn ON pn.code = p.fk_product_type
WHERE 
    DATE(sm.datem) BETWEEN :date_debut AND :date_fin
    AND e.ref = :entrepot
    AND c.label = :categorie
    AND pn.label = :nature
ORDER BY sm.datem, e.ref, p.ref
LIMIT :limit;

paiements_par_client.sql:
SELECT
    s.nom AS client,
    SUM(p.amount) AS total_paiements
FROM m38h_paiement p
JOIN m38h_paiement_facture pf ON pf.fk_paiement = p.rowid
JOIN m38h_facture f ON f.rowid = pf.fk_facture
JOIN m38h_societe s ON s.rowid = f.fk_soc
WHERE p.datep BETWEEN :start_date AND :end_date
GROUP BY s.nom
ORDER BY total_paiements DESC
LIMIT :limit
